'''Landing Bay Besh''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], a city on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. ''[[Lambda-11238]]'', commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Herkin]], once landed there.
